title: Phlebotomist I
description:
Pride Health is hiring Phlebotomist I (Float) to support our client’s team in Burlington, NC (Float Position covering Durham, Chapel Hill, Carrboro, and Roxboro, NC). This is a full-time, 13-weeks contract.
 
Job Summary:
We are seeking a reliable and patient-focused Phlebotomist I (Float) to support multiple Patient Service Centers throughout the Durham region. This role is ideal for a phlebotomist who enjoys variety, is comfortable traveling between locations, and thrives in a fast-paced clinical environment. The selected candidate will provide high-quality specimen collection services while ensuring exceptional patient care and adherence to laboratory standards.
 
Key Responsibilities:
  • Perform venipuncture and specimen collection following established procedures.
  • Verify patient identification and accurately label specimens.
  • Process, package, and prepare specimens for laboratory testing.
  • Maintain accurate patient records and documentation.
  • Follow laboratory quality, safety, and infection control standards.
  • Provide excellent customer service while ensuring a positive patient experience.
  • Support multiple laboratory locations as assigned.
  • Work effectively both independently and as part of a healthcare team.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and compliant work environment.
 
Qualifications:
  • Minimum 1+ years of phlebotomy experience
  • High School Diploma or GED required
 
Additional Information:
  • Location: Burlington, NC
  • Job Type: 13 week contract
  • Pay Range: $17 - $19 hourly
  • Shifts: 1st Shift (Mon–Fri; hours vary by assigned location)    
 
*Offered pay rate will be based on education, experience, and healthcare credentials.
Interested? Apply now!

title: SOX Admin Support - Remote
description:
SOX Admin Support

Location: Remote
Time Zone Requirements: Pacific Time Zone hours
Employment Type: 5-month W2 contract
Pay Rate: $90–$100/hour
Potential for Extension or Conversion: Could extend up to a 6-month assignment

About the Role

Russell Tobin is seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented, and self-starting SOX Admin Support professional to support a leading technology organization. This role will provide calendar and administrative support to multiple function leads within the Accounting organization, reporting into the team’s Leadership Business Partner.

The team is scaling quickly, so this role calls for someone who can build reliable systems, use judgment to prioritize competing requests, and lean on AI tools to stay efficient across a high volume of scheduling and administrative work.

This is a contract position focused on calendar management and administrative support, with some exposure to SOX-related administrative tasks.


Responsibilities

  • Manage and coordinate calendars for multiple function leads, resolving scheduling conflicts and prioritizing time based on shifting business needs
  • Serve as the primary administrative support for 1–3 executives or function leads
  • Coordinate and communicate with 30+ external partners, including consultants and auditors
  • Manage high-volume email communications with professionalism, responsiveness, and attention to detail
  • Build and maintain simple, reliable systems for tracking meeting requests, action items, and recurring scheduling needs across multiple leads
  • Proactively identify and resolve scheduling conflicts, double-bookings, and last-minute changes
  • Support light administrative tasks tied to SOX compliance processes, including tracking documentation, coordinating sign-offs, and maintaining records
  • Serve as a point of contact for multiple function leads on calendar-related questions and requests
  • Use AI tools to streamline scheduling, communication, and administrative workflows


You May Be a Good Fit If You

  • Are highly organized, with a proven track record building systems to manage multiple stakeholders’ schedules in a fast-paced environment
  • Have strong calendar management experience supporting senior executives or function leads
  • Have exceptional written communication skills, particularly via email
  • Are highly detail-oriented, organized, and proactive with strong follow-through
  • Are able to manage multiple priorities and stakeholders in a fast-paced environment
  • Are comfortable using AI tools to improve speed and accuracy in day-to-day work
  • Thrive in ambiguity and adapt quickly as priorities and processes shift
  • Have excellent attention to detail, follow-through, and discretion with sensitive information
  • Communicate clearly and professionally with senior stakeholders
  • Are comfortable working independently as a contractor, with minimal oversight once ramped up


Strong Candidates May Also Have

  • Prior experience supporting multiple executives or leaders concurrently
  • Exposure to SOX compliance processes or general familiarity with audit/compliance documentation
  • Experience working in a rapidly growing or fast-scaling organization
  • Experience coordinating with external partners, consultants, auditors, or other senior stakeholders

title: IT Support Specialist
description:
IT Support Specialist
Contract (6 Months + Possible extension)
New York, NY (Onsite)
 
Pay Rate- $22-26 an hour on W2 (DOE)
 
We are seeking an experienced IT Support Specialist to provide onsite technical support in our New York City office while collaborating with distributed teams across multiple locations. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys solving technical challenges, and is passionate about delivering an exceptional end-user support experience.
The ideal candidate is customer-focused, detail-oriented, and collaborative, with strong troubleshooting skills across Apple and Windows environments.
 
Key Responsibilities

  • Provide onsite IT support and serve as the primary point of contact for end-user technical issues.
  • Troubleshoot hardware, software, and operating system issues for Apple macOS and Windows laptops and desktops.
  • Image, configure, deploy, and maintain laptops and desktops using MDM and endpoint management tools such as JAMF, BigFix, and AirWatch.
  • Provision user accounts and administer enterprise applications, including Okta, Google Workspace, and other business software.
  • Install, deploy, and support software for end users.
  • Support conference room and audiovisual technologies, including Google Meet, projectors, audio/video conferencing, and meeting room equipment.
  • Assist with AV setup for internal meetings and company events.
  • Respond to and resolve support requests through the IT ticketing system as well as in-person support.
  • Manage hardware and software inventory, including asset tracking and lifecycle management.
  • Perform basic networking troubleshooting involving Wi-Fi, switches, and connectivity issues.
  • Escalate issues appropriately while maintaining clear communication and ensuring a positive customer experience.
  • Document solutions, procedures, and knowledge articles as needed.
 
Required Qualifications
  • 2–3+ years of experience in an IT Support, Desktop Support, or Help Desk role.
  • Experience supporting both macOS and Windows environments.
  • Hands-on experience administering Apple devices using enterprise management tools such as JAMF.
  • Experience imaging, deploying, and managing endpoint devices using MDM solutions (JAMF, BigFix, AirWatch, or similar).
  • Familiarity with identity and access management tools such as Okta and Google Workspace.
  • Experience working with IT ticketing systems and knowledge management platforms (Service Desk, Jira Service Management, Confluence, or similar).
  • Basic to intermediate networking knowledge, including Wi-Fi, switches, TCP/IP, and connectivity troubleshooting.
  • Strong troubleshooting, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent customer service, communication, and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to lift and move equipment weighing up to 50 pounds as needed.
 
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience supporting conference room AV technologies and video conferencing solutions.
  • Familiarity with ITIL processes and best practices.
  • Experience working in a fast-paced, high-growth technology environment.

title: Let's Connect – Supply Demand Planner Opportunity - Autin, TX
description:
Our client, a global technology company specializing in consumer electronics, software, and digital services, is looking to hire a Supply Demand Planner in Cupertino, CA.

Pay Rate Range: $45 to $48/hr on w2, depending on experience

Responsibilities:

Key Responsibilities

  • Ensure proper product allocation and execution by balancing supply and demand across distribution sites.
  • Develop and manage product supply plans that support quarterly financial and operational goals.
  • Serve as the cross-functional interface between Sales, Operations, Regional Planning Teams, and external partners.
  • Create and manage weekly allocation plans across supported channels.
  • Monitor reporting and execution to ensure supply commitments are met where inventory is available.
  • Evaluate supply chain risks and implement contingency plans to minimize customer impact.
  • Drive strategic supply chain initiatives that improve operational efficiency and long-term business performance.
  • Support New Product Introduction (NPI) operational activities to ensure successful product launches.
  • Identify process improvement opportunities across systems, tools, and workflows, and lead implementation efforts.
  • Manage supply execution across multiple distribution centers and origin locations.
  • Analyze backlog and open order data and make execution decisions with minimal supervision.
  • Support customer shipment commitments, fill-rate targets, revenue goals, and operational metrics.
  • Maximize daily billings while maintaining service-level expectations.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance operational performance and sustainability objectives.

 Requirements: 

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Business, Finance, Economics, Marketing, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in supply chain, operations, demand planning, supply planning, procurement, finance, consulting, or data management.
  • Proven experience managing supply and demand planning activities in a complex business environment.
  • Experience developing product supply plans and balancing inventory to meet customer demand and business objectives.
  • Strong understanding of product allocation, forecasting, inventory management, and supply execution.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to convert data into actionable insights.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, matrixed organization.
  • Strong organizational, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to proactively identify risks, recommend solutions, and manage ambiguity effectively.
  • Experience driving business process improvements and continuous operational excellence.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating across global teams.
  • Proficiency with SAP and advanced Microsoft Excel.
  • Experience creating recurring and ad hoc reports to support business decisions.

Preferred Qualifications

  • MBA or other advanced degree.
  • Experience supporting New Product Introduction (NPI).
  • Knowledge of Tableau or similar data visualization tools.
  • Experience with global supply chain operations and distribution center management.
  • Familiarity with S&OP, forecasting, inventory optimization, and allocation planning.
  • Experience managing supply chain risks and contingency planning.
  • Strong background in process improvement, operational excellence, and business transformation.
  • Passion for continuous learning, innovation, and improving supply chain performance.

description:
The Science Team at Pride Health supporting the Material Sciences Industry that has an opening for Environmental Specialist in Eagan, MN!
 
Position Summary:
We are seeking a detail-oriented Regulatory/Environmental Specialist II to support the International Product Stewardship team. This role focuses on process documentation, operational support, and cross-functional coordination to ensure efficient product stewardship and regulatory compliance activities. The ideal candidate is highly organized, analytical, and experienced in managing documentation within a regulatory, quality, or operational environment.
 
Additional Details:
Contract Length: 12 months with the possibility of extension
Pay range: $25 to $ 35 per hour on W2 (As per experience)

 
Responsibilities:
  • Support global Product Stewardship initiatives by improving process standardization and operational efficiency.
  • Develop and maintain process documentation, including standard operating procedures (SOPs), work instructions, RACI matrices, and standardized templates.
  • Organize, review, and manage controlled documentation while identifying gaps and ensuring alignment with regulatory and quality requirements.
  • Perform structured reviews of business documentation to verify accuracy, consistency, and compliance with internal standards and applicable regulations.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support data alignment, documentation updates, and process improvements.
  • Provide operational support for regional Product Stewardship activities, helping ensure timely approvals and workflow completion.
  • Assist in maintaining documentation systems and supporting continuous improvement initiatives.
 
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in Environmental Science, Regulatory Affairs, Chemistry, Biology, Engineering, Quality, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Experience working with structured documentation, SOPs, work instructions, or document control processes.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
 
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience in Product Stewardship, Regulatory Affairs, Quality Assurance, Environmental Compliance, or Quality Systems.
  • Knowledge of document management systems and Quality Management Systems (QMS).
  • Experience supporting regulated industries such as medical devices, pharmaceuticals, healthcare, chemical manufacturing, or consumer products.
  • Familiarity with process improvement methodologies and documentation best practices.
 
Key Skills
  • Product Stewardship
  • Regulatory Compliance
  • Environmental Compliance
  • SOP & Work Instruction Management
  • Documentation Management
  • Document Control
  • Process Documentation
  • Process Standardization
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Process Improvement
  • Microsoft Excel & Microsoft Office
 
 
Must be authorized to work in the United States.
